args.title: Decoupling capacitor C14 is also far from the radio supply pin
args.what: C14 sits 5.54 mm from U3, edge to edge.
args.why_it_matters: A long loop weakens decoupling at the radio.
args.recommendation: Move C14 closer to the U3 supply pin in your layout tool.

text: Yes, C14 is also too far from U3. I added it as a new finding with a pin on the board.
